post.description:
Registers a web device for end-to-end encryption when logging in via username/password (without QR pairing).

Flow:
1. User logs in via POST /auth/login → receives JWT
2. Client generates a new web X25519 key pair for this browser slot
3. Client calls this endpoint to register the device public key
4. Senders will now encrypt new messages for this device_id
5. If the client restores the historical identity key from GET /e2ee/backup, old history may be accessible on normal login too

The response includes `has_backup` flag: if true, client should prompt for master password
for explicit recovery flows. Fresh web keys still require QR history sync, while restored identity keys may open old history without QR.
